title: EcoPlace: code, frozen registrations and analysis outputs for "EcoPlace: Language Models versus Genetic Programming for Evolving Energy-Efficient Placement Policies in the Computing Continuum"
description: Code for the paper: the PlacementScript language and its Rust runtime, the discrete-event simulator of a fog/cloud cluster with its energy model, the LLM and genetic-programming search engines, and the baselines. It also holds the frozen study registrations, the launchers and analysis scripts of the six studies, their analysis outputs, and the scripts that regenerate the paper's figures. The raw run archives are in a separate record (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23964427). The Alibaba call-graph sample used by the tests is in another (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23964625).
notes: Funding: co-financed 85% by the European Union, the European Regional Development Fund and the Regional Government of Extremadura (Managing Authority: Ministry of Finance; project file IB24102; grant file GR24099), and project PID2024-155693NB-C41.
